title: An existing canonical section-Proj embedding gives ordinary relative ampleness
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X,F$ algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], $T$ an $S$-scheme, and $f:X\to h_T$ a quasi-compact separated presheaf map [def-sfb-space-quasi-compact-presheaf-map; def-sfb-presheaf-map-separated-diagonal]. Let $L$ be a line module on $X$, and $A$ a SectionProjModel of its actual section algebra [lem-trf-section-proj-etale-embedding; def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input]. Assume $A.\mathrm{sections}$ agrees with ordinary schemes [lem-trf-space-section-algebra-etale-base-change], its generation open is all of $X$, and $r:X\to h_{\operatorname{Proj}_T(A.\mathrm{affine})}$ is its canonical representable open immersion. Let $e:h_U\simeq X$ represent $X$ by an $S$-scheme $U$, with $e$ etale, and let $p:U\to T$ satisfy $h_p=e\mathbin{\gg}f$. For any etale $k:X\to F$ and $F$-module $M$ with an isomorphism $L\simeq k^*M$, the ordinary Zariski restriction of $M$ along $e\mathbin{\gg}k$ [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction] is invertible and ample on $p^{-1}(W)$ for every affine open $W$ of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. The conclusion uses literal open restriction. No cover or local-ampleness assumption occurs.

proof.text: Transport the quasi-compactness and closed-diagonal scheme tests along e. They imply QuasiCompact p and IsSeparated p, hence QuasiSeparated p. The etale scheme-test realization of the line module gives the ordinary invertible H corresponding to its restriction at e.

source.place: Tag 0D3C (lemma-descending-property-ample), final paragraph; morphisms.tex Tag 01VJ (5) implies (1); descent.tex Tag 03LC.

proof.text: Use AgreesWithSchemes to compare each homogeneous direct image and counit with its ordinary Zariski version. SectionProjModel identifies the graded products, unit, restrictions and evaluation on homogeneous sections. These identifications construct the ordinary RelativeSectionAlgebra and identify its generation and canonical chart formula with those of A. Representable open immersion of r transports along e to an open immersion of schemes.

source.place: Tag 0D3C (lemma-descending-property-ample), final paragraph; morphisms.tex Tag 01VJ (5) implies (1); descent.tex Tag 03LC.

proof.text: Apply the reverse canonical-Proj criterion to obtain ampleness of H over every affine base open. The isomorphism L = k^*M and composition of etale restriction identify H with schemeRestriction F at e followed by k. Restrict this isomorphism to each inverse-image open. Invertibility and ampleness are invariant under isomorphism; the open restriction/tensor comparison gives the stated literal restrictFunctor form.

theorem ordinary_ample_of_sectionProj_embedding
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (T : Over S)
    (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactPresheafMap f) (hsep : IsSeparatedPresheafMap f)
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : X.IsLineModule L)
    (A : SectionProjModel f (lineTestFamily X L hL))
    (hagrees : A.sections.AgreesWithSchemes)
    (hgen : A.evaluation.IsGenerationOpen ⊤)
    (r : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (projOver T A.affine))
    (hcanonical : A.evaluation.IsCanonicalMap ⊤ ((⊤ : Subfunctor X.obj.obj).ι ≫ r))
    (hopen : IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) r)
    (U : Over S) (e : yoneda.obj U ≅ X.obj.obj) (he : IsEtale e.hom)
    (p : U ⟶ T) (hp : yoneda.map p = e.hom ≫ f)
    (F : AlgebraicSpace S) (k : X ⟶ F) (hk : IsEtale k.hom.hom)
    (M : F.Modules) (z : L ≅ (pullback k hk).obj M) :
    ∀ W : T.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W →
      ∃ h : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
          ((F.schemeRestriction
            ⟨CostructuredArrow.mk (e.hom ≫ k.hom.hom),
              isEtale_comp _ _ he hk⟩).obj M)).IsInvertible,
        @Scheme.Modules.IsAmple (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
            ((F.schemeRestriction
              ⟨CostructuredArrow.mk (e.hom ≫ k.hom.hom), isEtale_comp _ _ he hk⟩).obj M))
          h
